svg.title: Substation technician — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as substation technician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A finned transformer has two collared upper bushings beside a separate visibly open disconnect switch. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
